confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader output, fallback text search, rendered methods/results pages, and a DOI/source-route check were reviewed. The static near/far speaker geometry, 150 ms pink-noise stimulus, 70 dB ear-level equalization, electrical tactile target, microphone response capture, no-racket/common-racket/personal-racket sessions, random 90-trial session structure, catch counts, and group-specific session counts are reported. Remaining gaps are exact far-sound lead time, ITI/jitter, numeric response window, exact tactile pulse/current, and the pink-noise source file/seed.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: The core audio-tactile PPS task can be recreated as a static near/far speaker design with no-racket, common-racket, and personal-racket blocked sessions. Exact replication would require assumptions for the unreported far-sound lead, ITI, response timeout, tactile pulse parameters, and pink-noise source.

source_checks.scope: PDF pages 2-4 for Experimental procedure, Figure 1, session structure, apparatus, trial counts, RT scoring, and results sanity checks.
Used as primary extracted text map and checked against rendered PDF pages and targeted text searches.
Targeted searches for pink noise, loudspeaker, near/far, 68.5 cm, 30 cm, 70 dB, trial, catch, random, baseline, SOA, ITI, tactile, Digitimer, microphone, and response terms.
Visual methods and figure check; temporary rendered page images were not committed.
Tracked ledger plus web/source route did not identify a supplement for this article.

review_attempts.result: Mapped automated candidate Segment 1-4 values across 16 of 25 fields.
Confirmed static near/far pink-noise speaker conditions, 150 ms duration, 70 dB ear-level equalization, 68.5 cm near-far spacing, and racket geometry.
Confirmed near sound/touch simultaneity and qualitative far-sound lead; no exact far lead, ITI, or jitter values were found.
Confirmed random within-session ordering of near, far, and catch rows, with no-racket/common-racket/personal-racket sessions counterbalanced as blocked conditions.
Confirmed 90 trials per session, 30 near audio-tactile, 30 far audio-tactile, 30 catch trials split 15 near and 15 far, and no separate tactile-only baseline.
Confirmed right-wrist electrical stimulation via DS7AH HV Digitimer, microphone voice response capture, and Matlab analysis of audio traces.
Rendered pages 2-4 were inspected and no supplement was found through the tracked DOI/source route.

stimulus_type.value: Auditory stimuli were 150 ms bursts of pink noise.
stimulus_type.evidence_note: The auditory sound class and duration are stated in the multisensory paradigm description.

source_provenance.value: Custom Matlab software synchronized electrical and audio stimuli and controlled trial order; exact pink-noise source file or seed is not supplied.
source_provenance.evidence_note: Software control is reported; reproducible audio asset provenance is incomplete.

trajectory_count.value: Two static auditory positions: Near and Far.
trajectory_count.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-3, Experimental procedure and Figure 1
trajectory_count.evidence_note: Near/Far is the spatial auditory factor.

trajectory_path.value: Near loudspeaker was close to the right hand, with the hand about 30 cm from the body; far loudspeaker was about 68.5 cm from the near loudspeaker, corresponding to racket tip placement in racket sessions.
trajectory_path.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-3, Experimental design and Figure 1
trajectory_path.evidence_note: The text and figure specify the static near/far geometry and racket length.

stimulus_speed.value: No moving or looming sound trajectory was used; sounds were emitted from static near or far loudspeakers.
stimulus_speed.evidence_note: The auditory manipulation is a static location factor.

auditory_conditions.value: Auditory location conditions were Near and Far, crossed with session/object conditions: no tennis racket, common tennis racket, and personal tennis racket for tennis players.
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: Location and object/session factors are reported.

gain_envelope.value: Near and far speaker volumes were individually adjusted so sound intensity was 70 dB at the participant's right ear.
gain_envelope.evidence_note: SPL equalization is reported; no dynamic gain envelope is needed for static bursts.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Two identical loudspeakers, a personal computer/custom Matlab synchronization, a DS7AH HV Digitimer stimulator, and microphone voice-response capture.
renderer_or_apparatus.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-3, Experimental procedure and Figure 1
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: The apparatus is described in text and shown in Figure 1.

trial_rows_families.value: Each session had near audio-tactile target trials, far audio-tactile target trials, and sound-only catch trials.
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: The 90-trial session composition lists the three row families.

condition_intermixing.value: Within each session, near, far, and catch trials were randomly ordered. Object/session conditions were separate sessions whose order was counterbalanced.
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: The paper reports random trial order within sessions and counterbalanced session order.

blocked_or_random_order.value: No-racket, common-racket, and personal-racket conditions were blocked by session; session order was counterbalanced among subjects, while trials inside each session were random.
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: Session blocking and trial randomization are explicitly reported.

iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: No ITI, inter-trial jitter, or distribution/range was found in the main PDF or source route.

response_window.evidence_note: Participants responded as soon as possible, but no numeric response deadline or scoring window was reported.

task_sequence_rules.value: Participants were blindfolded, responded verbally to the electrical tactile target, ignored the auditory stimulus, and withheld responses on sound-only catch trials; a familiarization phase preceded the experiment.
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: Target, ignore-sound, catch/no-go, and familiarization rules are reported.

tactile_stimulus.value: Electrical tactile stimulation was delivered at the right wrist through a surface bipolar electrode attached with Velcro and connected to a DS7AH HV Digitimer constant-current stimulator.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Modality, site, electrode, and stimulator are reported; pulse duration/current are not.

soa_table.value: Near acoustic and tactile stimuli were simultaneous; far sound began slightly before tactile onset to compensate for distance, but the exact lead time is not reported.
soa_table.evidence_note: The timing relation is reported qualitatively; exact far SOA is a caveat.

baseline_strategy.value: No separate tactile-only baseline is reported; PPS effects are estimated from near-versus-far audio-tactile reaction times within each object/session condition.
baseline_strategy.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-3, Experimental design and Data processing
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: The design uses near/far comparison rather than a distinct baseline row.

baseline_timing.value: No tactile-only baseline SOA schedule was used or reported.
baseline_timing.evidence_note: There is no baseline timing ladder in this design.

catch_trial_type.value: Catch trials were sound-only no-response trials split across near and far sound locations.
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: Catch type and near/far split are explicitly reported.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: Per session: 30 near audio-tactile target trials and 30 far audio-tactile target trials.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: Repetitions per near/far tactile condition are explicitly listed.

baseline_count.value: No separate baseline trials are reported.
baseline_count.evidence_note: There is no baseline row to count.

catch_count.value: Per session: 30 catch trials, with 15 near-sound-only and 15 far-sound-only trials.
catch_count.evidence_note: The catch count and near/far split are explicit.

block_count.value: Novices and tennis players completed no-racket and common-racket sessions; tennis players additionally completed a personal-racket session. Session order was counterbalanced.
block_count.evidence_note: Session counts differ by group because pTR applied only to tennis players.

total_trial_count.value: Each session contained 90 trials. Thus the reported structure gives 180 task trials for novices and 270 task trials for tennis players across their respective sessions.
total_trial_count.evidence_note: Per-session total is explicit; group totals follow directly from the reported sessions.

critical_caveats: This is a static near/far auditory task, not a dynamic looming/receding trajectory profile.
The exact pink-noise source file, random seed, and spectrum recipe are not supplied.
The exact far-sound lead time is not reported, only a qualitative compensation statement.
The exact electrical tactile pulse duration, current, and calibration rule are not reported.
ITI or jitter policy is not reported.
No numeric response deadline/window is reported for the voice/microphone response.
next_manual_action: Use this as a high-confidence static near/far racket/tool-condition template candidate. Exact recreation should label far-SOA lead, ITI, response window, tactile pulse parameters, and source pink-noise file as lab-default approximations unless a hidden protocol source becomes available.
